Job Opportunity for German Speakers!!

Our German Department is growing 📈 and we expanded to Austria and looking for a new Member to our Team!

Goral Assistance Germany / Austria

A boutique company is looking for a customer care agent for an administrative position, working with prestigious customers and international insurance firms providing medical services all of Germany for travelers. 

We are a small, intimate, boutique office, with great atmosphere and amazing people.
Our employees are our most valuable asset, handpicket to ensure the best level of teamwork and interpersonal relationships, as well as employee satisfaction.
Our headquarters are located in Raanan Industrial Park.

Responsibilities:
- Receiving and executing tasks in various channels such as clinics, doctors, hospitals etc.
- Management of a close relationship with international clients on a regular basis
- Providing professional and efficient customer support while ensuring high customer satisfaction while coordinating medical assistance. 
- Operation of processes in collaboration with medical suppliers in Germany and service providers in the medical field.
- Administrative work - creating  medical reports, working with logistic, back office

We offer a respectable salary to those who are suitable to our requirements:
- Ability to work 4-5 shifts a week. 
- Previous experience with administrative work and/or customer service - advantage
- Self-management abilities, planning, and prioritization of tasks.
- Customer-focused mindset
- Effective communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills
- Fluency in German and English is must! 
Additional languages would present an advantage.

The job is suitable to men and women alike.

CV to be sent to:
marcel@goralassist.com
